step_by_step_reasoning: I identified all 10 visual nodes from the whiteboard diagram and transcript, mapping them to their official AWS/ThirdParty/User service types. I then structured the arrows into three clear operational flows: Flow 0 captures the incoming Salesforce event trigger, normalization, and data storage into DynamoDB AD DATA. Flow 1 captures the Routing Lambda reading configuration and system credentials from DynamoDB CONFIG. Flow 2 covers the client application loading from S3, reading ad data from DynamoDB, and calling the Workflow Lambda function to execute ad creation tasks.

graph.name: Advanced Local Serverless Ad Creation Workflows
graph.notes: Advanced Local uses a serverless AWS architecture combining API Gateway, Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, and Cognito to automate ad creation workflows from Salesforce data.

nodes.name: SFDC
nodes.notes: Salesforce CRM storing product and creative information entered by sales reps.

nodes.name: CREATIVE API
nodes.notes: AWS API Gateway entry point receiving automated event payload triggers from Salesforce.

nodes.name: PARSING
nodes.notes: Lambda function that normalizes unstructured Salesforce data into standardized JSON format.

nodes.name: ROUTING
nodes.notes: Lambda function managing ad routing logic and credentials for downstream systems.

nodes.name: WORKFLOW
nodes.notes: Lambda function executing creative workflow tasks like proofing and ad generation.

nodes.name: CONFIG
nodes.notes: DynamoDB table storing routing rules and system login credentials.

nodes.name: AD DATA
nodes.notes: DynamoDB table storing parsed, standardized advertisement details.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Amazon S3 bucket hosting the static web front-end application.

nodes.name: COGNITO
nodes.notes: Amazon Cognito handling authentication and user pool management for secure single sign-on.

nodes.name: Mobile App
nodes.notes: Front-end application interface used by creative teams to build and proof ads.

edges.notes: Salesforce sends trigger payload to Creative API Gateway upon order completion.
Parsing Lambda writes standardized ad data into DynamoDB AD DATA table.
Routing Lambda reads routing configuration and downstream credentials from DynamoDB CONFIG table.
S3 serves web application code to the mobile app client.
Mobile app reads parsed ad information from DynamoDB AD DATA table.
Mobile app invokes Workflow Lambda function to execute ad creation steps.
